title: LLM4POL evaluator request -- charter section 7 (M2 freeze), EVAL-01
description: One batch of (candidate_id, properties) lookups sent to python -m llm4pol.evaluate. Frozen at M2: a change that a reported result depends on is a new schema version in a new file (charter section 4 A-5), never an edit of this one. Property keys are not enumerated here (the registry is protocol/property-registry_v1.yaml); an unregistered key answers `unsupported`. A candidate_id that is not 16 lowercase hex characters is a caller bug and a validation failure, never `missing`.
